newsitem.title: UK: Lower prices stir buyers on UK meals/feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Lower prices stir buyers on UK meals/feeds market.

text.p: Lower high protein soymeal prices on the UK meals and feeds market made buyers take an interest on Wednesday, but no business was reported by brokers.
"Buyers have been sniffing around, but one major player has been very aggressive and that is where the business has gone," said one broker.
High protein soymeal was down two to three stg a tonne while Brazilian 48's were four stg lower.
Brokers said there were no changes in the rest of the market.
